title: Argentinian Chicken Skewers with Crispy Exotic Peppers
description: A flavorful and colorful dish that combines the bold flavors of Argentinian cuisine with the exotic taste of peppers. Perfect for a summer evening or a BBQ gathering.

ingredients.name: Argentinian chimichurri sauce
ingredients.notes: Available at most grocery stores or online

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chimichurri sauce, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken and peppers to the bowl and toss to coat.
Thread chicken and peppers onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and peppers are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley and crispy garlic if desired.
